zh: 全球约五分之一的石油，要穿过这一道狭窄的海峡。
en: About a fifth of the world's oil passes through one narrow strait.
text:
全球约五分之一的石油，要穿过这一道狭窄的海峡。
About a fifth of the world's oil passes through one narrow strait.

zh: 这里是波斯湾通往外海的唯一出口。
en: It is the Gulf's only way out to the open sea.
text:
这里是波斯湾通往外海的唯一出口。
It is the Gulf's only way out to the open sea.

zh: 最窄处宽 21 海里，约 39 公里。
en: At its narrowest point, it is 21 nautical miles wide.
text:
最窄处宽 21 海里，约 39 公里。
At its narrowest point, it is 21 nautical miles wide.

zh: 水道够深，最大的油轮也能通过。
en: The channel is deep enough for the largest tankers.
text:
水道够深，最大的油轮也能通过。
The channel is deep enough for the largest tankers.

zh: 油轮分走两条航道，每条宽 2 海里。
en: Tankers keep to two lanes, each 2 miles wide.
text:
油轮分走两条航道，每条宽 2 海里。
Tankers keep to two lanes, each 2 miles wide.

zh: 2024 年，日均约 2000 万桶石油经过这里。
en: In 2024, that averaged 20 million barrels a day.
text:
2024 年，日均约 2000 万桶石油经过这里。
In 2024, that averaged 20 million barrels a day.

zh: 输油管道能绕开海峡，运走一部分，
en: Pipelines can carry some of it around the strait,
text:
输油管道能绕开海峡，运走一部分，
Pipelines can carry some of it around the strait,

zh: 但空余运力每天只有 260 万到 550 万桶。
en: but their spare capacity is only 2.6 to 5.5 million.
text:
但空余运力每天只有 260 万到 550 万桶。
but their spare capacity is only 2.6 to 5.5 million.

zh: 对大部分石油来说，没有别的出路。
en: For most of this oil, there is no other way out.
text:
对大部分石油来说，没有别的出路。
For most of this oil, there is no other way out.

en: Most of it heads for Asia.
text:
其中大部分，运往亚洲。
Most of it heads for Asia.
